participation.context: Is the person the kept letter speaks to. She is not in the room.
participation.name: Anne Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote the London ones and put a stroke through each. You kept the short letter as it stood, and you did not add a promise.

title: Struck three beginnings, and kept the fourth

participation.context: Sealed the sheet and wrote the direction.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.name: Anne Shakespeare

participation.context: Named as the carrier. Not in the house.
participation.name: Thomas Hobbins

story.body: You addressed the outside to Anne and named the carrier and the day. You did not take it out of the room.

title: Sealed Anne's letter for the eleventh

participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Named in the letter. Not present.
participation.name: Anne Shakespeare

story.body: You refused the improvement, and you refused the new total.
